description.narrative: Insatsen riktar sig mot internflyktingar i östra delen samt återvändarområden i östra Abchazien. Arbetsområden är jordbruk, förbättrat näringsintag samt sysselsättning.
The project targets IDPs in the Eastern part of Georgia and returnee areas in Abkhazia, focusing on agriculture, improved nutrition and livelihoods.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Improved dietary diversity in both target regions - with regard to nutrition, over 80% of the target population scored good or adequate - compared to less than 50% at baseline.
320 families received input and training to establish environmentally friendly home gardens. By the end of the project 85 % of them continue to use the new agricultural methodologies.
In East Georgia, the construction of irrigation systems in Tsilkani and Shaumiani provided water access to a total of 612 IDP families.
More than 2 400 children in Abkhazia have improved knowledge and practice of nutrition, environment and sustainable agriculture through the involvement in Integrated School Gardens in 21 schools.
In East Georgia, 21 small businesses out of 22 supported are still operational and generate income. Out of 47 internship candidates, 25 former interns remain employed.
In Abkhazia, 82 families have sustainably increased their household revenue through income generating projects.
Out of 95 graduates from Agriculture Training Centres in Abkhazia, 18 found employment on local plantations and others started agriculture income generating projects. The three established centers continue to operate after the project.
A total of more than 3 800 community members in Abkhazia used Community Association services, which have helped lower costs of transport, land cultivation and pest control and positively impacted their livelihoods.
The Community Based Organisations in East Georgia have improved capacities through a variety of trainings and have received funding from other donors. Their projects reach more than 400 beneficiaries and have good sustainability potential.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
